notes.title: Update
notes.content:
I've updated the game to include a new title screen, music player, gender selection and the protaongist graphics.

You will may have noticed that some parts of the story have now been removed (because they are no longer fit the narrative).  There are lots to be added though, and general story tweaks.  That won't happen for a long while yet, though.

The DLC's haven't been updated yet, and may not work - that will come a lot later on, unless people mention it.

If you want to play the game and have the DLC's, you will have to remove the RPA files manually
